title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Trio #24 (ItalianDeruta+KoreanEunipsa+SpanishTalaveraReina / PeruvianNazca+GeorgianMinonkari+UkrainianPysanka / AmericanArtDeco+CroatianHvar+TurkishIznik)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Vietnamese woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, soft porcelain skin, delicate rose-pink eyeshadow, glossy soft-coral lips, demure and soft, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes. Long square nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions, wide cobalt-and-ochre bands, dense repeating floral border) dominates one zone. Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework, wide bold silver bands, dense lattice fills) dominates the second zone. Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions, wide cobalt bands, dense floral medallion border) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, a fierce, playful expression, bold and confident, pure icy-white hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Peruvian Nazca painted pattern (a deep terracotta ground densely painted with stylised gold figures, wide gold bands, dense stepped geometric borders) dominates one zone. Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel (a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, wide gold bands, dense cloisonné floral wirework) dominates the second zone. Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework, wide gold-and-red bands, dense geometric wax-resist linework) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Romanian woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm fair-olive skin, thick dark straight-edged brows, a heavy black liner smoked out at the outer corners, deep brown shadow blended up to the crease, long dense lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour, a deep red matte lip with a crisp edge, an intense, proud expression, sultry, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes. Long round nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst, wide silver chrome bands, dense zigzag linework) dominates one zone. Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework, wide gold bands, dense fine filigree linework) dominates the second zone. Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands, dense floral scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: both arms raised overhead.

Right woman's footwear: extreme ballet heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
